Initial decision (superseded by round 1 review): v6.0.0-alpha.5. v5 passes status and HTTPS probes but does not pass
sp07's in-process, no-executable shallow local clone. No status algorithm or
line counter from the spike is copied into production; process.LineCounts
remains the only production line counter.

Round 1 review decision: stable v5.19.2. The status and shallow HTTPS probes
cover product requirements. No product path shallow-clones a local repository:
the runner never clones and user skill sources are GitHub owner/repo or HTTPS.
The local-file transport failure is retained as evidence, not a rejection reason.
Fetch tests must serve their repository over HTTP, never a local file path.
